Dataset
	

A manually annotated dataset was created to enable supervised training for the FinBERT-PT-BR model, which focuses on sentiment analysis of Brazilian Portuguese financial texts.
More than 1.4 million financial news texts in Portuguese were collected and used for the initial language modeling phase. From this corpus, a sample of 1,000 texts was manually annotated with sentiment labels.
